svg.title: Read-after-write consistency with a two-of-three quorum
svg.desc: Time progresses downward along the client and replica timelines. The client writes x = v1 at timestamp t1. The write to A is lost. B and C both acknowledge the write. Then the client reads x from all three replicas. The read to C is lost. A replies (t0, v0), and B replies (t1, v1). The two quorums overlap at B. Since t1 > t0, the client returns v1.
